items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes overlapping duplicate deliveries both passing the check before either records the event ID and both processing it.
Gap 1 says the deduplication key comes from X-Event-Id, the signature covers only the body, and a replay can use a fresh forged header value.
Gap 2 identifies that the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, preventing refund handling.
None of the gaps depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
